title: Luxury Gifts Under $50 That’ll Impress Anyone (Without Breaking The Bank)
intro: This holiday season, we’ve found the gifts that feel great to get and even better to give. Shop our collection of editor-approved holiday gift guides here.

We've already tackled under-$50 beauty gift sets, but now we’re more broadly highlighting under-$50 luxury gifts. Because even if you’re browsing for that hard-to-shop-for friend or well-deserving mother, you can still pamper them while staying within your budget.

We've sourced the best affordable luxury gifts for everyone on your list, whether they're a homebody who lives in cozy slippers, fashion lover who fancies statement accessories, foodie who’s into tinned fish, or hosts who throw decadent dinner parties. Think: luxe beauty finds, artisanal kitchenware, and even elevated games (like puzzles.

Read on to discover (and shop) these under-$50 gifts that look far more expensive than they actually are, and will have your giftees wondering just how much you generously spent on them. (Only we'll know you only spent a week's coffee budget on it — and we're not telling!)
All linked products are independently selected by our editors. If you purchase any of these products, we may earn a commission.

items.name: Piecework Puzzles Happy Hour Puzzle
items.desc: 2026 emphasized more than ever our craving for analogue activities and hobbies that pull us away from our phones. So puzzles, especially ones as beautiful as the artwork from Piecework Puzzles, make for thoughtful gifts. It's a relaxing, time-consuming activity that leaves your giftee with a stunning piece of art. There are numerous designs to pick from, but we're eyeing this colorful cocktail tablescape.

items.name: Quince Lightweight Cotton Cashmere Crew Cardigan
items.desc: If you want to impress your gift recipients with high-quality yet budget-friendly gifts, you have to look to Quince. The selection of under-$50 gifts spans accessories, home decor, and, our favorite: cashmere sweaters. Consider a cozy cardigan that's a bit more versatile and can be worn across seasons.

items.name: Lululemon Metallic Nano Crescent Bag
items.desc: For the Lululemon lovers on your list, consider this new metallic mini bag-keychain hybrid. It can be hooked onto a larger Lululemon bag for extra personalization. The festive design is small but practical (it can fit your coins, earbuds, lip balm, or house keys).

items.name: Anthropologie Bistro Tile Stoneware 24k Gold Accent Pitcher
items.desc: The entirety of Anthropologie’s Bistro Tile collection is stunning with its mosaic look and artisanal feel, making tons of items perfect for gifting to your holiday party hosts… or yourself. This under-$50 pitcher is a classic style for holding Thanksgiving gravy, signature Christmas cocktails, or flower bouquets year-round.

items.name: Lush Karma Massage Bar
items.desc: Lush's viral massage bars are viral for a reason. I myself got persuaded and purchased a citrus scent over the summer and couldn't get over the super-moisturizing formula, which left me with glowing skin, or the invigorating scent, which gained me many compliments. There are many many scents to pick from, including calming and meditative scent combos. (Tip: Purchase a $5 oval tin online to hold the bar too. They're usually sold out in-store!)

items.name: JW Anderson X Uniqlo Wool Cashmere Stole
items.desc: Uniqlo knows how to do a designer collab right, and its latest with JW Anderson is full of high-quality pieces at reasonable prices. Gift these wool-cashmere scarves in multiple color combos, stamped with the JWA logo. This functional and fashionable unisex design is great for nearly everyone on your list.

items.name: GloryByAbbey Custom Photo Strip Wood Frame
items.desc: It was truly the year of photo booths. Friends and couples scoured their cities for the best photo booths, leaving with vintage-style photo strips. Because of this, we've also noticed an influx in photo strip frames. Whether you DIY one or support a small business on Etsy and customize it online, there are tons of designs available to display you and your giftee's favorite shared memories.

items.name: Nécessaire The Hand Cream + The Tube Key
items.desc: Anyone would be delighted to be gifted anything from bodycare brand Nécessaire. We recommend the bestselling hand cream, but elevating it more with the brand’s stainless steel tube key to help squeeze out every last drop of the moisturizing goodness.

items.name: Staub 16 oz. Petite Tomato Cocotte
items.desc: This mini heirloom tomato-shaped cocotte doubles as a mini Dutch oven and statement serving bowl (perfect for side dishes) that’ll instantly enhance any meal or tablescape. It’s so beautiful, no one will guess how much (or little) you spent on it.

items.name: Fotofoto Zero Waste Recycled Disposable 35mm Film Camera
items.desc: Whether you're shopping for a Gen Z giftee, a nostalgia lover, or a frequent traveler, a disposable film camera is a great under-$50 option to help them document special moments in an instant without taking 30 identical photos on their phone. Even better, this particular camera is made from up-cycled materials and comes with a mailer from Fotofoto to send the camera back to get photos developed (and recycle the camera after the fact).

items.name: Free People Frostbite Fur Pillbox Hat
items.desc: Your giftee will look like they're stepping out of a luxe '80s ski resort with this retro faux fur pillbox hat. Pick from leopard print, caramel, or cream designs to best fit your giftee's style.

items.name: Fishwife The Spicy Trio with Gift Tin
items.desc: Tinned fish lovers assemble! Fishwife’s gift tins — like this smoked salmon, albacore tuna, and sardines trio spicy olive oil and hot pepper — will delight foodies. Because who doesn’t love unwrapping niche treats during the holidays?

items.name: BaubleBar Bubble Letter Custom Necklace
items.desc: Baublebar’s custom charm jewelry was a reader-favorite last year, so we had to spotlight it again. Opt for a more modern and youthful version of a nameplate necklace with these puffy letter charms in either gold (for $48) or sparkly gold pavé (for $50).

items.name: Godonlif Candle Warmer Lamp with Timer
items.desc: A candle warmer is one of the best gifts I’ve ever been given. It quickly fills up my space with my favorite scent, and doesn’t wear down my candle like a flame does, so I can reheat it over and over again. And from the gift-giver perspective, it's a low-lift, high-reward option!

items.name: Julie Pedersen The Bread Baker's Seasoning Kit
items.desc: At this point, we probably all know someone who has taken up sourdough bread-making in the last couple of years. We think an ideal gift for spicing up their baking is this bread seasoning kit, which contains 15 jars of sweet and savory seasoning blends like Tuscan Tomato, Green Tea Sesame, and Dill Caraway.

items.name: Ugg Men's Suede Clamshell Logo Gloves
items.desc: Who knew you could find Ugg gloves under $50. Well, you can at TJ Maxx, and these men's suede gloves are calling our names. Cart them up for your father, brother, partner, or friend and leave them in awe over the very generous gift.

items.name: Kylie Cosmetics Mood Stones Mini Trio Gift Set
items.desc: Kylie Jenner knows a thing or two about viral moments, and her fragrances are no exception. The mogul released these new mood stone scents over the summer and got everyone hooked. On the chance that your giftee hasn't already carted up one of these perfumes, consider buying this mini trio scent so they can test out their favorites. They're also the perfect travel size for throwing in weekender bags and suitcases.

items.name: Charles & Keith Croissant Charm
items.desc: A bag charm that's also a coin purse that's also a croissant? What more do we have to say? We're loving this design, but Charles & Keith has so many adorable bag charms to pick from that'll put a smile on your giftee's face.

items.name: Crocs Classic Cozzzy Slipper
items.desc: Unless you look closely, you’d never know these faux-fur shearling slippers are from Crocs. Super cozy and plush, they’re the perfect option for the homebody on your list! And even better, they’re currently on sale!

items.name: Lilly Pulitzer 2027 Large 12 Month Agenda
items.desc: Just because your budget is $50 doesn't mean you need an inexpensive version of a luxury gift. Instead you can get a super luxe version of an ordinary gift, like an agenda. And this chic zebra-print 2027 agenda calendar is just that! It'll add a bit of whimsy to your giftee's everyday routine.

items.name: Maison Balzac Hand Cake Server
items.desc: From chrome fortune cookies to sparkling ornaments, Coming Soon offers some of the most unique and elevated under-$50 homeware gifts. But we’re eyeing this kitschy hand-shaped cake server for the baker, host, or sweets-lover on your list.

title: The Best Beauty Advent Calendars of 2026 (So Far)
intro: This holiday season, we’ve found the gifts that feel great to get and even better to give. Shop our collection of editor-approved holiday gift guides here.

Fall is almost here, and you know what that means: The holidays are just around the corner. And while it may be early, that hasn’t deterred brands from releasing some of their big-ticket holiday items. Case in point: Beauty-stuffed advent calendars.

While these blockbuster sets usually come at a premium price point, that's for a few reasons: They tend to be limited in quantity, feature exquisite packaging, and contain myriad products, including full sizes or limited-edition shades.

All that's to say is that the beauty-filled advent calendars you'll find here are not only marvelous to ooh and aah at but also provide a surprisingly good value, given the ample contents inside. (Pro tip: Find a buddy to go halfsies with and divide the spoils.) And while advent calendars are inherently an exercise in patience, we won't tell if you open up all the teeny-tiny doors the day it arrives on your doorstep...

At Refinery29, we’re here to help you navigate this overwhelming world of stuff. All of our market picks are independently selected and curated by the editorial team. All product details reflect the price and availability at the time of publication. If you buy or click on something we link to on our site, Refinery29 may earn commission.

items.name: 111Skin 11 Days Of Radiance Advent Calendar
items.desc: I don't know many people willing to spend upwards of $600 on skincare, but if you are: This calendar is the way to do it. British luxury skincare brand 111Skin is filled with full- and travel-sized products from beloved collections like Black Diamond, Rose Gold, and more.

items.name: Charlotte Tilbury Charlotte's Hollywood Beauty Wonderland Advent Calendar
items.desc: Charlotte Tilbury's advent calendar is always one that sells out — and fast. Don't miss out on getting this collectible heart-shaped treasure chest featuring drawers of glamorous makeup and skincare.

items.name: Express Your e.l.f. 24-Day Advent Calendar
items.desc: Reader-fave brand e.l.f. Cosmetics has blown us away with its dazzling beauty advent calendar, which features a mix of makeup, skincare, tools, and more. Best of all, the showstopping set includes 18 full-size products but clocks in at $95 — a serious steal, if you ask us.

items.name: Revolve Beauty 2026 Advent Calendar
items.desc: Revolve is perhaps best known as a destination for party-ready fashion, but don't sleep on the retailer's beauty offerings. Case in point? This seriously stacked advent calendar, which includes a mix of 25 full- and travel-size products from luxury brands like Summer Fridays, Ouai, Dr. Dennis Gross, and more. (There's also a 12-day version retailing for $89.)

items.name: UO 2026 Beauty Advent Calendar
items.desc: This 12-day calendar is jam-packed with $140 worth of beauty from UO-beloved brands like Le Monde Gourmand, Vacation, Starface, and more.

items.name: Liberty Beauty Advent Calendar 2026
items.desc: If you can’t hop on a flight to Heathrow this holiday season, this advent calendar from Liberty London is the next best thing. Not only is the packaging utterly divine, but there’s over $1,700 (the highest value to date) worth of luxury products inside from brands like ILIA, Violette_FR, and Jones Road, among others.

items.name: Benefit Cosmetics The Hotel Beneville Beauty Advent Calendar
items.desc: We can always count on Benefit to dream up a whimsical take on holiday sets, and this year’s blockbuster advent calendar (reimagined as boutique hotel) is chock full of all your Bene-faves. Encased in 24 mini boxes, you’ll find a mix of full-size and miniature mascaras, blushes, skincare, and much, much more.

items.name: Lush Advent Calendar
items.desc: ​​Calling all Lushies: If you love nothing more than taking a gorgeously scented, candy-colored bath, then Lush’s advent calendar is for you. Encased in a keepsake trunk so you can restock it with anything from jewelry to makeup, this blockbuster features 25 hand-selected favorites to encourage some much-needed self-care this holiday season.

items.name: Ulta Beauty 25 Days of Beauty Calendar
items.desc: Ulta girlies, this is the advent calendar for you. While the retailer is known for its semi-annual 21 Days of Beauty sale, this calendar presents 25 days of counting down via beauty products from brands like Tatcha, Ole Henriksen, and Anua, among other notable names.

items.name: L'Occitane Advent Calendar
items.desc: Getting anything from French beauty brand L'Occitane is always a treat, but perhaps even more so when unboxed from a visually stunning advent calendar. Inside this luxe set, you'll find several full-size products alongside minis of the brand's most bestselling beauty treasures.

items.name: Kiehl's 24 Days of Joy 2026 Advent Calendar
items.desc: Kiehl's always knocks it out of the park with its advent calendars, and this year is no exception. The American apothecary-inspired brand is encouraging festive feelings this year with its 24-piece calendar featuring a who's who of Kiehl's bestselling formulas: Creamy Eye Treatment, Ultra Facial Cream, Midnight Recovery Concentrate, among other stars.

items.name: L'Oréal Paris 12 Day Ultimate Holiday Beauty Advent Calendar 2026
items.desc: Say oui to 12 days of L’Oréal Paris bestsellers, including full-size favorites like Panorama Mascara, Telescopic Mascara, Colour Riche Lipstick, Lumi Le Glass Stick, Infallible Blurfection Powder, Setting Mist, and more.

items.name: Dedcool Advent Calendar
items.desc: For the ultimate fragrance snob, this DedCool advent calendar delivers. Alongside the brand’s signature perfumes, you’ll find body care, laundry essentials, and home fragrances, making it a fun way to discover the full range of its scent offerings.

items.name: ELEMIS The Ultimate Advent Calendar
items.desc: This skincare advent calendar is bursting at the seams with $913 worth of luxe products from British beauty brand Elemis, making it the ultimate gift for the beauty lover on your list.

items.name: Nudestix 12 Days of Blush Box Advent Calendar
items.desc: Nudestix's blush-themed advent calendar is proof that there's truly no such thing as too much blush. Inside, you'll find several shades of the beloved Nudies multistick, in addition to SPF-infused blush serums, and much more.

items.name: Olive & June 12 Days of Mani Magic Holiday Calendar
items.desc: Olive & June's 2026 nail advent calendar just dropped — and is better than ever. Don't miss out on snapping up these jam-packed sets featuring 11 exclusive and sold-out polish shades, plus a duo of top coats for every mani mood. (There's also a Pressies one for the press-on nail connoisseur.)

items.name: Burt's Bees 12 Days of Joy Lip Balm Advent Calendar
items.desc: Cold weather is synonymous with dry, chapped lips, which makes this Burt's Bees lip balm advent calendar a no-brainer gift for anyone on your list. One for their purse, every room, the car, and backups — many, many backups.

items.name: MAC 24 Days Of M·A·C Icons Advent Calendar
items.desc: MAC never disappoints with its holiday offerings, and they've pulled out all the stops for its 2026 advent calendar. Behind 24 doors, you'll find MAC faves like the Macstack Mascara, M·A·Cximal lipstick, Lipglass, and much more.

items.name: Glow Recipe 12 Days of Glow Advent Calendar
items.desc: For $110, you get 12 full- and travel-size Glow Recipe products ranging from the beloved Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops to toner pads, lip care, and more.

items.name: IPSY 25-Day Advent Calendar
items.desc: For the beauty fanatic on your list, you won't find a better gift than IPSY's advent calendar, bursting at the seams with nearly $700 (!) worth of products from Briogeo, Glow Recipe, Gisou, and more.

items.name: Bluemercury 31 Days of Dazzle 2026
items.desc: Bluemercury's impossibly chic advent calendar is packed with luxe beauty finds from brands like 111Skin, Oribe, and Parfums de Marly. With a whole 31 days of surprises to unwrap, it's the kind of indulgent gift that keeps the holiday magic going past Christmas.

items.name: 2026 OLIVE YOUNG x Sephora Advent Calendar
items.desc: Getting your Olive Young fix just got a whole lot easier — no flight to Seoul required. This limited-edition advent calendar features 12 K-beauty Hall of Fame brands curated by the retailer, making it the ultimate gift for anyone chasing that dewy, chok-chok glow.

items.name: Victoria's Secret 12 Days Of Bombshell Advent Calendar
items.desc: For the bombshell on your list, this Victoria's Secret advent calendar contains varieties of its signature warm floral Bombshell fragrance, in addition to body products, shimmer mists, VS trinkets, and more.

items.name: Dermstore 24 Days of Beauty Advent Calendar
items.desc: Calling all skincare savants: Dermstore's festive calendar is jam-packed with professional-grade skincare to get you glowing into the new year.

items.name: Voluspa 12 Day Alpine Advent Calendar
items.desc: When else but during the holiday season can you get 12 mini candles in one glorious box set? Unboxing them may be fleeting, but hours of scent will take you all the way to 2027.

items.name: Laneige 12 Days of Wonder Korean Skincare & Lip Favorites Advent Calendar
items.desc: Calling all K-beauty lovers: This dewy set of Laneige favorites includes a mix of full-size and six mini versions of Laneige’s bestsellers. Ones to get excited for: The iconic Lip Sleeping Mask, JuicePop Box Lip Tint, Water Bank skincare, and much more.

items.name: Tatcha 12 Ways to Love Your Skin Advent Calendar Gift Set
items.desc: This advent calendar features 12 mini versions of Tatcha's bestsellers, including The Rice Polish, The Dewy Skin Cream, The The Longevity Memory Cream, among others.

items.name: Sisley Paris 24-Day Advent Calendar
items.desc: It may rival the cost of a new iPhone, but this Sisley Paris calendar is truly a showstopping gift for the ultimate French beauty lover on your list. Packed with full- and mini-sizes of your favorite Sisley skincare, haircare, and makeup, it's easily among the most luxe advent calendars to come across our radar.

items.name: NYX Professional Makeup Bling Box 24 Day Holiday Advent Calendar
items.desc: Unbox 24 days of viral beauty favorites from NYX, including multiple shades of the TikTok-famous Fat Oil, Butter Gloss, and more.

title: 16 Gifts For The Friend Who Collects Perfume Like Memories
intro: This holiday season, we’ve found the gifts that feel great to get and even better to give. Shop our collection of editor-approved holiday gift guides here.

Gifting fragrance can be a tricky game, but it’s not impossible. Sure, you could always head over to your department store counter or bestseller wall, but if you’re looking for a fragrance gift to really impress this season? Let’s just say we have a couple in mind.

Whatever their scent style, we're here to help steer you towards the most unique, joy-sparking perfumes to dazzle anyone and everyone on your list. Whether you’re looking to transport someone to the beaches of Miami or make them the best-smelling person in the room, keep clicking to find 16 editor-approved fragrance gifts sure to delight the senses.

At Refinery29, we’re here to help you navigate this overwhelming world of stuff. All of our market picks are independently selected and curated by the editorial team. All product details reflect the price and availability at the time of publication. If you buy or click on something we link to on our site, Refinery29 may earn commission.

items.name: Bond No.9 Women's Luxe Trio
items.desc: This stunning trio of Bond No.9 scents features three 50ml bottles of my favorite scents from the brand — Greenwich Village, Nolita and Nomad — and is perfect for sharing with friends or keeping all to yourself as you grow your own perfume collection.

items.name: Rare Beauty Rare Moments Eau De Parfum Rollerball Mini Duo
items.desc: As a self-professed perfume snob, I was seriously impressed by Selena Gomez's fragrance debut last year. Then, IMO, she outdid herself with her sophomore release, Rare Beginnings. This adorable rollerball duo lets you experience both scents, each offering a completely different (but equally Rare-coded) fragrance mood: one fresh and fruity, the other warm and comforting. Plus, the miniature bottles are practically made for tossing into your bag for midday touch-ups.

items.name: Summer Fridays Sunlit Vanilla Set
items.desc: Summer Fridays' fragrance debut was one of my favorite beauty launches of 2026, making this gift set a no-brainer for anyone on the hunt for their next favorite vanilla perfume. I'm particularly obsessed with the blend of caramel, coconut, and bergamot, which creates a warm, creamy scent that feels cozy without veering too summery. And considering the full-size bottle alone retails for $82, getting that plus a travel spray and cosmetic case? Girl math at its finest.

items.name: Marc Jacobs Daisy 4-Piece Mini Perfume Discovery Gift Set
items.desc: If you know someone (or are that someone) who’s dreamed of frolicking in a field of wildflowers ever since first seeing Marc Jacobs’ Daisy ads, this festive set is a steal at under $100 — not that your recipient would ever guess. Inside, your lucky giftee will discover a mini garden of different varieties encased in Christmas cracker-inspired packaging.

items.name: Tom Ford Private Blend Deluxe Discovery Set
items.desc: Who doesn't love a little Tom Ford under the tree? This impossibly chic discovery set brings together four of the brand's most iconic fragrances, spanning the decadent, cherry-soaked Lost Cherry, smoky-sweet Tobacco Vanille, beach-resort-coded Soleil Blanc, and bold, woody Oud Wood. Consider this the gift of smelling expensive.

items.name: Hermès Barénia Eau de Parfum Gift Set
items.desc: I treated myself to a similar version of Hermès' Barénia gift set during the Nordstrom Anniversary Sale, but if you missed out, fear not. This duo includes a full-size bottle of the brand's addictive, skin-like Barénia, plus a travel spray for keeping your signature scent close, whether you're commuting, jet-setting, or simply refreshing on the go.

items.name: Cyklar The Bestsellers Perfume Oil Gift Set
items.desc: Without a doubt, perfume oil is one of the most sensual ways to wear fragrance. There's the ritual of applying it, the subtle sheen it leaves on skin, and the bonus of using it as a base to help other fragrances linger longer. Cyklar is quickly mastering the art of the perfume oil, and this quartet of its bestselling scents — Sacred Santal, Vanilla Verve, Sex Musk, and Naked Neroli — offers a little something for every mood, from cozy to come-hither.

items.name: Miu Miu Mini Miutine Eau De Parfum Perfume Duo Gift Set
items.desc: I not-so-secretly love strawberry fragrances, and Miutine is my current favorite. With warm brown sugar and floral gardenia rounding out the juicy fruitiness, it's playful yet ladylike in the most Miu Miu way possible. This duo includes two adorable minis — a travel spray and a Honey, I Shrunk the Kids-sized version of the brand's signature matelassé bottle. All for under $40? A luxury fragrance steal, if you ask me.

items.name: Ellis Brooklyn ISLA TIME Mini Perfume Duo Gift Set
items.desc: We haven't even reached the dead of winter, but for the person who's already dreaming of an island escape, Ellis Brooklyn's tropical perfume duo is just the ticket. It includes teeny-tiny bottles of ISLA SIRENA, a mermaid-coded blend of coconut water, blue java banana, and lime, alongside my personal Ellis Brooklyn favorite, Miami Nectar, a sun-drenched cocktail of pink pineapple, coconut water, and vanilla. OOO mode: activated.

items.name: Sephora Favorites Holiday Women's Perfume Sampler Gift Set
items.desc: I'll say it every year: Gifting fragrance can be tricky unless you're replenishing someone's signature scent or know their tastes really well. Enter Sephora's perfume sampler set, aka my favorite hack for giving someone a fragrance they'll actually love. With 20 scents to choose from, the odds are very much in your favor. The set includes a treasure trove of Sephora bestsellers in sample sizes (which, trust me, last longer than you'd think), plus a voucher to redeem a favorite for a full-size bottle online or in-store. The gift that keeps on giving, indeed.

items.name: The 7 Virtues Mini Amber Orchid & Vanilla Woods Eau de Parfum Duo Gift Set
items.desc: This right here is your ultimate cozy-girl scent combo. Vanilla Woods is an all-time favorite in my fragrance collection, and I'm convinced newcomer Amber Orchid is her long-lost soulmate-slash-bestie — that's how beautifully they complement each other. Together, they're subtly sweet, warm, and inviting, with an airy, skin-like amber floral quality that gives off that "naturally smells good" energy.

items.name: Sidia The Strike
items.desc: Leave it to IYKYK lifestyle brand Sidia to reimagine portable fragrance as an endlessly refillable, keepsake-worthy object. Meet The Strike, a chic scent atomizer that lets you choose from three of the brand's signature fragrances: warm and cozy Braless, earthy Soaked, and sunny Midas. Consider it your new favorite way to take your signature scent everywhere — and make every reapplication feel like a little luxury.

items.name: Glossier Mini Glossier You Wardrobe Kit
items.desc: I audibly squealed when I spotted this Glossier You perfume set in-store — that's how good it is. Perfect for the Glossier obsessive on your list, this quartet of ambroxan-based fragrances is a skin-scent lover's dream, offering four takes on that signature your-skin-but-better magic. (Plus, the tiny bottles are the ultimate beauty-girl keepsakes.)

items.name: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa All the Way Mini Perfume Mist Gift Set
items.desc: Spread some holiday cheer — or should we say, Cheirosa — with this set of six Sol de Janeiro fragrance mists. The lineup includes fan favorites like caramel-forward '62 and fruity-floral '68, plus the chance to discover a new signature scent in picks like nutty, gourmand '71 and juicy, plum-forward '40. Consider it a one-way ticket to smelling delicious.

items.name: Kylie Cosmetics Kylie Jenner Mood Stones 3-Piece Discovery Gift Set
items.desc: IMO, Kylie Jenner has yet to miss when it comes to her growing fragrance empire. Her first foray beyond the Cosmic collection came in the form of Mood Stones, arguably her most elevated perfume offering yet. This discovery set lets you sample all three scents — Cashmere Muse, Blush Wood, and Velvet Brew — and mix, match, and layer to your heart's content.

items.name: NOYZ Only Human Layering Set
items.desc: There's no shame in knowing what you like — especially when it's as good as NOYZ's Only Human. This set lets you wear the sultry-sweet scent three ways: as an eau de parfum mist, a moisturizing milky lotion, and a solid perfume stick for on-the-go touch-ups. Layer them together for a fragrance ritual that goes the extra mile, or wear each one solo. (The chic faux-leather mini purse is just the cherry on top.)

title: The Data Is In: These Are The Best Products To Gift, According To Readers
intro: This holiday season, we’ve found the gifts that feel great to get and even better to give. Shop our collection of editor-approved holiday gift guides here.

Like you, we love a good gift guide, and have released quite a few based on the categories, interests, and types of giftees we're all shopping for this holiday season. title: 25 Gifts For The Woman Who Has Everything & Wants Nothing
intro: This holiday season, we’ve found the gifts that feel great to get and even better to give. Shop our collection of editor-approved holiday gift guides here.

We all have those people in our lives — the ones who say they don't want anything for the holidays — whether they feel like they already have everything they could need, or simply don’t like the attention that comes with gift-receiving. But, come gift-giving season, those same people are inevitably handing you a meticulously wrapped, thoughtful present… and you don't really want to be empty-handed in that moment. What, then, makes a good gift for the hard-to-please person?

Whether you want to go down the route of practical gifts that they’ll definitely use on a daily basis or little luxuries that they’re totally deserving of, we curated a range of thoughtful gifts for your mom, best friend, grandmother, favorite coworker, or any other special woman in your life.

For the homebody, consider scent diffusers or towel warmers. For foodies and dinner party hosts, cart up artisanal olive oil or salt and pepper grinders. And for avid travelers, look to wool compression socks and suitcase closet organizers. No matter your giftee’s aesthetics or interests, there’s a range of thoughtful self-care, beauty, lifestyle, entertainment, and fashion presents ready to be purchased.
Ahead, find 25 foolproof gifts for the woman who claims to want nothing, from little luxuries she’d never buy herself to practical finds she’ll use on repeat.
All linked products are independently selected by our editors. If you purchase any of these products, we may earn a commission.

items.name: Lola Blankets Wild Moss Medium Lola Weighted Blanket
items.desc: We're starting strong (and heavy) with one of Lola Blankets' weighted blankets. The beloved luxury blanket brand always has its praises sung with fans declaring that it's worth every penny. Your giftee may already own an original cozy blanket from the brand, so consider one of the weighted styles in a variety of sizes and designs if your budget allows for it.

items.name: Brighter Day Pigments DIY Watercolor Paint Set with Travel Pouch
items.desc: 2026 was the year of analogue hobbies, and we think the desire for hands-on activities will continue well into 2027, so why not purchase a sweet watercolor paint set? This one has a few Anthropologie-exclusive postcard prints and pouch designs to pick from. The neat watercolor pen and travel-sized paint tin are chef’s kiss for the friend who likes to get creative wherever they go.

items.name: Flamingo Estate Personalized Heritage Olive Oil
items.desc: You've probably seen Flamingo Estate's iconic heirloom tomato candle in almost every gift guide (or have gifted one already), but the luxury lifestyle brand has so much more to offer. And its food, like the olive oil, shouldn't be slept on, making this personalized EVOO bottle an amazing gift for a mother, holiday host, or home chef. Write a short, sweet note and leave a long-lasting effect with your giftee.

items.name: Maison de Sabré The SABREMOJI Fruit Charm
items.desc: Whether she’s a seasoned jet-setter... or a forgetful person, you can upgrade her AirTag game with these joyful fruit charms, intended to keep AirTags safe and stylish, personalizing everything from house keys to suitcases (I wear one on my work bag!). Pair it with a new AirTag for an extra thoughtful touch.

items.name: Free People Sunday Button Snood
items.desc: A snood is the cozy solution to staying warm and stylish throughout the winter that isn't your everyday scarf (Because guess what? She doesn't need another one). This is a great option for your super stylish friend. She can wear it under her seasonal coat and oversized button-down top or over a cardigan for extra cozy coverage and dimension.

items.name: Shark ChillPill 3-in-1 Personal Cooling System with Fan
items.desc: Shark's ChillPill fan was perhaps the most viral beauty tool of the year. And it is absolutely a little luxury, which many people say is worth the splurge. The portable fan stands out in price and quality because of the cooling plate and dry-touch mist for actually cold air. So if you're shopping for a giftee who runs hot, this is a gift they'll definitely need and want.

items.name: Hulken Small Rolling Tote
items.desc: I've never met someone who doesn't love their Hulken rolling tote bag, including myself. While I use the large size for storage, others use it for laundry days, or opt for the smaller size for everyday commuting and grocery shopping. It's so versatile and practical, and with three sizes and multiple colors, you can pick the one that best fits your giftee's needs and lifestyle.

items.name: West Elm x Emma Chamberlain Pigeon Glasses Holder
items.desc: Personally, I love Emma Chamberlain's quirky aesthetic, from her Architectural Digest home tours to her West Elm homeware collection. So if you have someone on your list with a similar aesthetic, check out the decor pieces for a gifting moment. This pigeon-shaped glasses holder is great for quirky decorators, sunglasses collectors, and NYC residents.

items.name: Bombas Merino Wool Blend Everyday Compression Knee High Socks
items.desc: There's a high likelihood that your giftee already owns a pair of Bombas slippers or ankle socks. But the brand also offers compression socks that are perfect for the frequent flyer or avid hiker. And for an extra-luxurious touch, the merino wool options are extra comfy and warm.

items.name: MacKenzie-Childs Mocha Check Electric Salt & Pepper Grinder Set
items.desc: Who doesn't love fancy salt and pepper shakers? These electric grinders from stylish hand-painted ceramics brand MacKenzie-Childs are an incredibly chic option to gift. Order and of the four checkered colorways to fit your giftee's space, then sit back, relax, and wait to receive shock and awe for the thoughtful present.

items.name: Ouai x Heaven Mayhem Fragrance Amulet Necklace
items.desc: We can bet that even the woman who has everything doesn't have this new Heaven Mayhem necklace filled with Ouai perfume! items.name: LAnnodoMacrame Custom Hand Crank Photo Album

items.name: Big Night Aperitivo Spoons Set

items.name: Checked Compression PackAway Closet

items.name: Granado Best-Sellers Perfume Suitcase

But if they're new to the brand, consider a suitcase full of mini perfumes so they can test and figure out their favorites before purchasing a full size.

items.name: Camp Snap Transparent Screen-Free Digital Camera
items.desc: It's time to get nostalgic with a Y2K-inspired, colorful, jelly-looking camera. These Camp Snap options are like a hybrid of a digital camera and a disposable camera. items.name: Quince Mongolian Cashmere Ribbed Wrap
items.desc: Known for its luxe and budget-friendly cashmere, Quince needs to be on your radar when shopping for the woman who has everything. We’re thinking out of the box for your hard-to-shop-for giftee with this chic and versatile cashmere wrap.

items.name: Abbode Embroidered Dog Mom Small Croc Pouch
items.desc: Abbode is a one-stop shop for the cutest and chicest personalized gifts. While there are so many styles to pick from, we've been eyeing this pouch for the dog moms in your life. This design can be personalized with several dog icons and text and used for everyday essentials, cosmetics, or travel must-haves so that your four-legged friend is never too far.

items.name: Nori The Nori Press
items.desc: The woman who’s constantly traveling for work trips or vacations will appreciate this top-rated portable iron. The compact design — which comes in several cheerful colorways — quickly presses, steams, and irons six different fabric types, making it a practical, must-pack item.

items.name: Urban Outfitters Swan Shaped Metal Ring Holder
items.desc: Sometimes we just need an unexpected design on an everyday essential, like a jewelry holder, to put a smile on our faces and make our daily routines a little less mundane. items.name: Bobbi Brown x The Met Holiday-Exclusive Luxe Lipstick
items.desc: Whether she's into makeup, art, or both since they often overlap, consider something from this new collaboration from Bobbi Brown and The Met. items.name: Devyn Samara My Favorite Book Keepsake Necklace
items.desc: You really can't go wrong with any gifts from Uncommon Goods, but these book locket necklaces stood out, especially if you're shopping for an avid reader. If you can't come up with a new book recommendation, consider this necklace, which highlights one of your giftee's favorite classic books, like Pride & Prejudice or The Great Gatsby.

items.name: Pura 12-Day Advent Calendar
items.desc: While you may love carting up seasonal candles for yourself, we promise that the hard-to-shop-for woman in your life doesn't want another one. Instead, check out this unique advent calendar, which includes a Pura fragrance diffuser with 12 fragrances to unbox and try throughout the year. Then, she can keep the diffuser and re-stock her favorite scents to fill her space.

items.name: PalmRidge Custom Handcrafted Aluminum Matchbox Holder
items.desc: At this point, you may have seen these custom matchboxes across many TikTok gift guides, and they're just so good that we had to include them here too! Pick from various embossed design options like cherries and butterflies or custom names and birth years. These are a sweet and unique gift (especially during the widespread matchbook obsession) to have lying around the house.

title: Bowen Yang & Matt Rogers Curated The Ultimate Cool Girl Gift Guide
blocks: If there’s one thing we can count on Bowen Yang and Matt Rogers for, it’s a hyper-specific pop culture reference. For the last decade, the comedic duo have mined the deepest corners of queer cultural zeitgeist on their podcast Las Culturistas, which snagged iHeartRadio’s Podcast Of The Year Award in 2023. This holiday season, their new Marshalls campaign — It’s Giving Gifts! — channels their encyclopedic archive of niche archetypes into the highest form of holiday-season community service: helping shoppers find the perfect present for every type of person in their lives.

From best gifts “for the homebody who loves their sourdough starter more than you, and you have accepted that” to selections for “the cool girl who is always late and makes you think punctuality is kind of embarrassing” and “the teen who has so much drip you were left with no choice but to use the word “‘drip’ to describe them” — each gift guide offers meticulously curated, cross-category selections from designer labels and beloved brands at a wide variety of price points.

“Saying that you love Marshalls is like ordering Diet Coke for the table,” Yang tells Refinery29 while we chat in-store at Marshalls in Manhattan. “You empower other people to say something they thought was buried: ‘Oh, wait, I’ve always loved Marshalls too.’”
Below, Yang and Rogers share their best tips for picking the perfect gift, their most formative holiday memories, and the greatest presents they’ve ever given — and received.

blocks.name: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Eau De Parfum
Victoria Beckham 55mm Oval Sunglasses
Tula Gold Glow And Get It Eye Balm

blocks: Let’s talk about my personal favorite gift-guide archetype — gifts for “the cool girl who is always late and makes punctuality seem kind of embarrassing.” To reference the recurring segment on your podcast — what are the cultural moments that made this cool girl who she is today?

Bowen Yang: We all know this girl. We might even be this girl. This girl saw Mean Girls in theaters at least 5 times in 2004. She really imprinted on — not Romy and Michelle — but she identified with their bullies. Maybe [they identify] with Janeane Garofalo ’cause they like a quick-smoke cigarette because they have places to be and they are always late to those places.
Matt Rogers: I would say it's that girl from high school who you're like: "You learned the wrong thing from Regina George.” But… she looked good.
There’s so many cute purses and shoes in the “cool girl” gift guide. Where is the cool girl wearing these accessories while out and about in Manhattan?
Yang: She’s taking this to Balthazar, Carbone, the Whitney, the Circle Line Cruise so she can swing around [her purse] while the DJ plays a song on a boat.

Rogers: She’s going to take this to Zero Bond. She’s going to walk past Taylor Swift, and Taylor’s gonna go: “So sorry, where did you get that bag?” She’ll say: “Marshalls.” And she’s going to wink at Taylor, and Taylor's gonna be like: "Travis, we gotta go. Let's get to Marshalls."

blocks.name: Shiraleah Char Faux Leather Woven Beauty Pouch
Ganni Mid Cut Chelsea Booties With Cap Toe Detail
Natasha Rhinestone Handbag

blocks: Be honest, did you have any specific friends in mind when creating the “cool girl”” gift guide?
Yang: I would say our friend Greta [Gerwig] — who we love. Greta is giving both Sabrina Carpenter and early aughts SJP, plus the dad’s girlfriend from The Parent Trap.
Rogers: Yeah. Any stepmother from any movie where the stepmother comes in and is like: "It's off to boarding school with you.” But we love that stepmother. We aspire to be her.
For the person who just can’t decide on a gift — what picks from your gift guides do you think are the most universal crowd-pleasers?
Yang: Silk pajamas, skincare… this bag is a star. This bag has been with us the entire campaign. And I will never forget about her — she's high impact.
Rogers: And you really can't go wrong with a candle.

blocks.name: Candlebis Cbd Infused Apothecary Collection Candle
Dalia MacPhee Satin Pin Dot Pajama Set

blocks: You’re clearly both great gift-givers — but what about receiving? Was there a childhood gift that genuinely shaped who you are today

Rogers: This was the year that PlayStation 2 came out. I was a video game kid — Bowen Yang still is — and I really wanted that PS2. And they were like: "You're not getting it. It's too expensive and no one can get it." And then on Christmas day, I kept opening up PS2 games, and I was like: "Well, I guess you got me the games for one day when I get the system, right?" They were like: "Exactly, one day when you get the system." Low and behold, the last gift hiding under the couch was the PS2, and I was a very happy boy.
Yang: Mine was after Batman Forever came out. I had a Batgirl, Alicia Silverstone action figure — that really spoke to me and has since.
What’s the most unexpected place you’ve ever spent the holidays?

Yang: Someone in my family recently pitched, out of nowhere: “What about Scottsdale this Christmas?” I said: “What about it? We don’t know anybody there.” No shade to Scottsdale it’s just like... why would we go there?
Rogers: I will be doing a Tampa Christmas because my parents snowbird down there. People who know me are like: “Matt Rogers, Florida for Christmas, checks out.”

blocks.name: Steve Madden What The Fuzz Beret
Ugg Shearling Sheepskin Exposed Gloves

blocks: What are your favorite types of gifts to give?

Yang: Candles are a go-to. I think we're finally, as a culture, coming out of the stigma around candles as gifts. For a while there, it was like: "Oh, you got a candle? How impersonal." No. No one's gonna turn down a candle.

Rogers: I really hit the jackpot one year when I realized that I could get bespoke drink coasters and customize them for my friends. So I got coasters with different pop stars on them and I gave them to all my friends for the pop star that they stan. And I do think that was my best idea and now I have to think of something else creative.

title: 23 Gifts He Doesn’t Know He Actually Needs
