items.name: Abercrombie & Fitch Essential Popover Hoodie
items.desc: This super soft, no-fuss hoodie is perfect for everyday wear, and is the perfect gift if you have yet to "return" the sweatshirt that you "borrowed" ages ago.

items.name: Otterbox Symmetry Series Cactus Leather for MagSafe
items.desc: We say this with love, but men are not always the gentlest creatures with expensive gadgets. If he has the cracked iPhone screen to back up this claim, it’s time to gift him a phone case that will not only look good, but will also protect his device from falls, drops, and other accidents.

items.name: Smythson Dreams And Thoughts Panama Notebook
items.desc: Sure, his Notes app gets the job done, but we’d argue that handwritten notes are becoming a lost art. This elegant Smythson notebook is perfect for jotting down bon mots, grocery lists, spontaneous love letters…shall we continue?

items.name: Aimé Leon Dore Unisphere Hat
items.desc: He’ll know a cool dad hat when he sees it. (Aka…right when you give it to him!)

items.name: The Best Paste Matte Firm Hold Hair Paste
items.desc: Celebrity groomer Kristan Serafino (whose A-list clients include Ryan Reynolds, Willem Dafoe, Jake Gyllenhaal, and other leading men) is behind The Best Paste — an easy-to-use styling pomade, which is the next best thing to sitting down in her chair.

items.name: Columbia Mickey Mouse and Friends Fleece Pullover for Men
items.desc: Disney meets après ski — and dare we say, it works? For the Mickey to your Minnie, we love this wintery, '90s-chic fleece from heritage brand Columbia's collab with everyone's favorite cartoon mouse.

items.name: Crocs Xbox Classic Clog
items.desc: Sure, he might already own a pair of Crocs, but not these limited-edition ones featuring his other true love — his Xbox. Plus, it's the perfect gamer gift for your forever Player Two.

title: Leah Kateb’s Ultimate Gift Guide For PPG, Boyfriends, & Yourself
intro: This holiday season, we’ve found the gifts that feel great to get and even better to give. Shop our collection of editor-approved holiday gift guides here.

Leah Kateb isn't stressed about holiday shopping — and you shouldn't be, either. This festive season, the Love Island star is teaming up with Amazon to make crossing everyone off your gift list as easy as possible. "Honestly, you have to make it fun," she says of navigating the busiest shopping weeks of the year. But what's more fun, giving gifts or receiving? "I would definitely say giving — gifts are one of my love languages."

The Los Angeles native (and proud Horse Girl) takes it as a point of pride to curate the ultimate assortment to help her followers navigate holiday shopping with creativity, thoughtfulness, and most importantly, fun. "I personally do my Amazon storefront," she tells me of her creator page. "I take it very seriously." (Girl, we can tell!)
From cozy home finds for her PPG besties Serena Page and JaNa Craig to what she's eyeing for boyfriend Miguel Harichi, keep clicking to see what's made Kateb's very own wish list.

At Refinery29, we’re here to help you navigate this overwhelming world of stuff. All of our market picks are independently selected and curated by the editorial team. All product details reflect the price and availability at the time of publication. If you buy or click on something we link to on our site, Refinery29 may earn commission.

items.name: Barefoot Dreams CozyChic Throw
items.desc: "Serena just moved and JaNa has a house, so I'm thinking of getting them cute throw blankets and knickknacks for around their homes," says Kateb, who features this cult-adored cozy essential on her storefront. (Psst, it's on sale for Black Friday!)

items.name: Milk Makeup Balmade Electrolyte Lip Balm Variety Pack
items.desc: Another gift pick from Kateb's storefront: This extra-giftable lip balm trio from Milk Makeup, featuring three tubes to give to friends (or keep for yourself).

items.name: Meta Quest 3S 128GB
items.desc: For the significant other who's been very nice this year, Kateb has the perfect recommendation for all the guys out there. "Miguel and I just got a house together, so he's been setting up his game room," shares Kateb. "I'm definitely going to be getting him some tech toys."

items.name: La Jolie Muse Wall Hanging Planters for Indoor Plants
items.desc: Calling all plant parents: These floating mini planters (another gem sourced from Kateb's storefront) instantly elevate any space, and are surprisingly easy to install.

items.name: Rolove Vanity Mirror with Lights
items.desc: As for what Kateb is gifting herself this year? "I'm about to deck out my new glam room," she reveals. "I've already ordered new makeup, shelves, LED lights...I'm definitely spoiling myself."

items.name: Vienrose 12.60x13 Inch Self-Adhesive Photo Album
items.desc: "I love sentimental gifts — for my one year anniversary with Miguel, he gave me a picture book of us throughout the year," she shares. "That was really, really sweet." Make your own unforgettable photo book gift with a keepsake-worthy album filled with unforgettable moments.

items.name: Suatien Mulberry Silk Pillowcase Standard Size
items.desc: Silk pillowcases are one of those gifts that feels so indulgent and luxe, but doesn't have to come at a triple-digit price point. Case in point: These silk-blend pillowcases from Kateb's hair-focused edit) that come in a rainbow of colors.

items.name: Philosophy scent-sational hydrating bath & shower gel
items.desc: For the beauty lover who loves to smell good, we recommend this Kateb-approved vanilla body wash from Philosophy.

title: Working on Your Christmas List? Here’s Somos’ Latine Holiday Gift Ideas For 2025
intro: Nochebuena is just over a month away, and if you still have names on your holiday gift list you haven’t crossed off (first, same!), we’ve got you. The Somos team put together an extensive gift guide for every Latine in your life. Organized by beauty, fashion, home, wellness, kids, him, and stocking stuffers, it’s packed with Latine-owned goodies that will look adorable under your Christmas tree and are guaranteed to bring photo-worthy, cheesy smiles to your loved ones’ faces. And that’s what gift-giving is really about, isn’t it? Spreading sweet joy.
All linked products are independently selected by our editors. If you purchase any of these products, we may earn a commission.

items.name: Tata Harper's Holiday Glow Kit
items.desc: Colombian-owned luxury skincare brand Tata Harper is iconic for a reason. With natural formulations, its products are as effective as they are indulgent. The Holiday Glow Kit is perfect for the skincare connoisseurs who already love the brand and for anyone looking to start or upgrade their routine. This six-piece collection includes the Regenerating Cleanser, Resurfacing Mask, Hydrating Floral Essence, Rejuvenating Serum, Repairative Moisturizer, and a Green Beauty Towelette. And the set is packaged in a beautiful festive green box, so there’s no need for wasteful wrapping.

items.name: Dezi's Pack It All Multi-Purpose Hanging Travel Bag
items.desc: Have a homegirl who’s always traveling? Trust us, she needs to upgrade her toiletry bag, and Dezi’s Pack It All Multi-Purpose Hanging Travel Bag will definitely be her new favorite. Measuring 12 x 11 inches, it has plenty of space for full-size beauty products. Even better, multiple clear and mesh zippered pockets let her neatly separate and organize every must-have. The bag also includes a rotating hook, so she can hang her essentials wherever she’s at. Oh, and have you seen that deep brown floral pattern? The bag is absolutely gorgeous.

items.name: Vive Cosmetics' Liquid Lipsticks Holiday Kit
items.desc: Your favorite Latina influencers are obsessed with Vive Cosmetics’ lippies. This Sacramento-based beauty brand has perfected the textures, shades, and long-lasting formulas everyone loves. Their Dulce Holiday Kit is the perfect gift, featuring two of the brand’s Que Matte Liquid Lipsticks in shades ranging from deep browns like Morenita, to wine reds like Amor Eterno, to nudes like Spanglish.

items.name: Love U Mucho's Hydrating Travel Size Kit
items.desc: And, of course, your girlfriend will need to fill her new bag with travel essentials. For haircare, Dominican-owned brand Love U Mucho has everything she’ll need. The Hydrating Travel Size Kit includes shampoo, a hydrating mask, leave-in conditioner, and a heat-protectant wave spray. Formulated to restore and moisturize hair, it’ll keep her tresses on point wherever she’s globetrotting.

items.name: 12 Days of Candy Land x Beauty Creations Advent Calendar
items.desc: Beauty lovers of all generations will delight in Beauty Creations' 12-Day Candy Land Advent Calendar. Each day reveals a new treat: Shimmer Body Lotion, Shimmer Body Mist, Blush Brush, Powder Blush, Cream Blush, Liquid Blush, Loose Powder, Lashes, Applicator Brushes, Lip Balm, Lip Liner, and a Shadow Palette. This Candy Land-themed holiday set is a colorful winter wonderland, full of sweet scents and nostalgic charm.

items.name: Lights Lacquer’s Are We Cool? Bundle
items.desc: It wouldn’t be winter without a new Lights Lacquer drop, and as always, the holiday bundle does not disappoint. Are We Cool? is a gorgeous vegan nail polish and nail accessories collection filled with sleek finishes, modern tones, and a frosted glow. The set includes glittery charms and shades like metallic Brain Freeze, dusty pistachio Buddy, dark magenta Cold Hearted, translucent Frosted Tips, periwinkle Ice Princess, and deep blue-black Winter Is Coming.

items.name: Ceremonia’s The Spaliday Reset Kit
items.desc: For the one who knows the struggle (and pain) of a dry scalp, there’s Ceremonia’s The Spaliday Reset Kit. This limited-time gift set features the Chilean-Swedish-owned brand’s best-selling, deep-cleansing Papaya Scalp Scrub and its deliciously scented Guava Hair Mask. Together, the duo exfoliates the scalp, removing buildup with papaya enzymes and pink salt, while nourishing strands with superfruit guava.

items.name: Luna Sundara's Palo Santo and Huayruro Bracelet
items.desc: Wellness and spiritual girlies need cute accessories, too. Enter Luna Sundara. The sustainable, Peruvian-owned brand handcrafts ceramics and incense holders as well as wild-harvested wellness essentials like palo santo, smudge sticks, and essential oils. This beautiful beaded bracelet is made from Peru-sourced palo santo wood and Huayruro seeds — both traditionally used in medicinal rituals and associated with good luck and wealth — giving someone on your gift list a unique and meaningful piece of jewelry to wear every day.

items.name: LAKRAS' Bera Bag
items.desc: For the stylish friend who refuses to sacrifice sustainability for a good look, there's Lakras' Bera Bag. The Colombian brand works with local artisans who hand-make this lightweight, sculptural over-the-shoulder bag from upcycled aluminum caps. The metallic bag is a futuristic take on “reuse and rebirth.”

items.name: Greene is Gold's Mindy Heart Locket Necklace
items.desc: Well-made, thoughtfully designed jewelry that preserves moments and stories are the kinds of pieces that become heirlooms, and that’s exactly what Black Boricua designer Mikaela Greene creates through her brand Greene is Gold. Her handmade resin jewelry feels like wearable gardens. From locket necklaces to charm bracelets to wristwatches, each piece incorporates flowers Greene hand-picks from farms across the country. “I dry or press them by hand, then create a hand-mixed resin background that sets the tone for the colors and feeling of the piece,” Greene explains. “From there, I build in small layers, adding flowers intuitively, unless it’s a custom piece with specific requests." Greene is Gold’s ready-made pieces, like the Mindy stainless steel locket necklace, are beautiful and meaningful on their own. But you can also customize a piece to make it personal. “I’ve had people send in flowers from funerals, share their partner’s favorite colors down to the hex code, or even show me photos of themselves and ask me to make something with creative freedom that I think they’d like,” Greene says. “I’ve always been a lover girl, so getting to create something that helps people express care, connection, and emotion feels so fulfilling.”

items.name: Min & Mon's Anastasio Mini Crossbody Handbag
items.desc: It’s been a rough year for many in our communities, so why not spark a little whimsy with your gift? Colombian-owned, New York-based, art-inspired accessories brand Min & Mon brings much-needed imagination and playfulness to these times. The husband-and-wife duo behind the brand craft bags, wallets, charms, and more that honor Colombian craftsmanship and are just really fun. This black leather Anastasio Mini Crossbody Handbag features a bold tiger-and-snake print that instantly adds personality to any outfit and will become a conversation starter.

items.name: Tara Chial's Mariposita Necklace
items.desc: Eclectic people make the world a better place, so put a smile on your quirky bestie’s face with Tara Chial’s Mariposita Necklace. Deeply rooted in Panamanian culture and artistry, Tara Chial’s handmade, timeless jewelry celebrates texture, color, and heritage, and it's designed to be passed down through generations. “Tara Chial is for women who value artistry and authenticity, and who appreciate pieces that feel both refined and handcrafted. She loves versatility and ease when dressing up, drawn to a polished yet colorful look that moves effortlessly from day to night," the Panamanian-born, New York-based founder and designer tells Refinery29 Somos. This 15-inch freshwater pearl necklace features an eye-catching, beaded, colorful butterfly pendant that’ll brighten your bestie’s day and everyone they cross paths with.

items.name: Jam+Rico’s Wavescape Ring with Stone
items.desc: Jam+Rico is a jewelry brand that celebrates Caribbean culture, heritage, and storytelling. Founded by Puerto Rican-Jamaican designer Lisette Scott, each vibrant, bold, and colorful piece draws inspiration from different Caribbean countries. The Wave Ring captures the gentle rise and fall of Caribbean waves, while the semi-precious brown stone adds a natural, earthy touch. Perfect for the friend who feels connected to nature, this piece will elevate any look and help them receive the messages of tranquil waves, like how life, like the ocean, has its ebbs and flows and that moving with grace and patience can lead to calm and clarity.

items.name: Hija de tu Madre’s “I Speak English, But I Love in Spanish” Hoodie
items.desc: Hija de tu Madre is a beloved brand across the community because founder Patty Delgado and her team truly understand the multicultural, “no-sabo” experience of so many second‑ and third‑generation Latines. If that sounds like someone you love, trust us — they’ll adore this “I Speak English, But I Love in Spanish” hoodie. The cold-weather essential is unisex, comes in black or red, and is perfect for cozying up while repping their “de aquí y de allá” identity.

items.name: Hedley & Bennett's 6-Piece Tool Set
items.desc: Whether you know someone who loves being in the kitchen or wants to love being in the kitchen, Hedley & Bennett's 6-Piece Tool Set is the perfect gift. In shades of red, white, and (our fave) green, this set from the Latina-owned brand comes with all the platinum-grade silicone and stainless steel essentials they’ll need: a spatula, turner, tongs, utility spoon, spoonula, and ladle.

items.name: Here & Always Candle Giftset
items.desc: If you haven't heard, Here & Always is a newly launched Latino-founded marketplace featuring handcrafted gifts by independent, design-led artisans across the U.S. Its Purpose Candle Collection — a trio of candles poured in East Los Angeles — serves as a love letter to the neighborhood’s immigrant communities. Created by Ely Valdivia of Earthy Corazón, the discovery set includes the Juniper Jade, Mezcal Moon, and Chamomile Canyon candles. And it’s truly a gift that keeps on giving: profits are donated to community partners like Make Good, Inc., a Los Angeles nonprofit serving foster youth and vulnerable children.

items.name: Luz y Tierra's Corazón Vase
items.desc: Handmade in Guanajuato, Mexico, Luz y Tierra’s Corazón Vase will bring a touch of love to any room. The heart-shaped vase is the sweetest way to display seasonal blooms. Fill it with a small bouquet, single stems, or dried flowers, and watch your loved one’s smile widen.

items.name: Caminito's Suave Campo Blanket Roll
items.desc: Give the gift of coziness this holiday season with Caminito's Suave Campo Blanket Roll. The Mexican-American mother-daughter duo behind the brand works with artisans in Mexico and crafts their colorful blankets from their Bay Area studio. The Suave Campo throw is a cozy plaid design with timeless, rustic charm. It’s the perfect gift to keep someone you love warm during the colder months and to take outdoors for a picnic when it starts to warm up again.

items.name: Casa Evita's Sacred Heart Mug
items.desc: Casa Evita is a brand that pays tribute to the love, warmth, and craftsmanship of Latina abuelitas, and this hand-crafted Sacred Heart Mug will remind your amiguis how loved they are every time they sip their morning cafecito or té.

items.name: Anelia Co.’s Silicone Barro Meal Set
items.desc: If you haven’t heard, Anelia Co. is one of the coolest emerging kid brands around. The Latina-owned, family-run business crafts sustainable baby essentials inspired by Latine heritage. Ashley Zamora created the brand in 2023 after a family dinner in Mexico. “My two-year-old son wanted to use a traditional clay plate like everyone else. When the plate inevitably broke, it sparked an idea: Why not create traditional designs specifically made for little hands? This moment of inspiration led us to collaborate with local artisans in Mexico and develop partnerships with manufacturers worldwide,” she tells Somos. That’s when she launched the brand’s best-selling Silicone Barro Meal Set. The set includes a cup with lid and straw, a suction-cup-bottom bowl with lid, a suction-cup-bottom plate, and a fork and spoon — all made from high-quality silicone that’s free from BPA, phthalates, PVC, BPS, and latex. Recommended for babies six months and up, the set helps little ones practice self-feeding while developing fine-motor skills.

items.name: Gabby’s Dollhouse's Meow-mazing Interactive Dollhouse
items.desc: With Gabby’s Dollhouse, Afro-Latina kiddos get a character who truly gets them. And with Spin Master’s Gabby’s Dollhouse: The Movie, Meow-mazing Interactive Dollhouse, they can bring all the Nickelodeon magic home. At two feet tall, the colorful dollhouse features seven themed rooms and a cat-tastic play area. It’s interactive, so kids can explore, move pieces around, and engage with the house in multiple ways. There are six play modes, including two games, music, elevator rides, and more, making it a fully immersive, hands-on experience for little fans.

items.name: LEGO's Isabela Flowerpot
items.desc: LEGOs aren’t just fun. They also help kids develop creativity, problem-solving skills, and fine motor coordination. And now LEGO has several sets inspired by Disney’s Encanto, so kids can feel seen in the worlds they’re building. Isabela’s Flowerpot features a hinged basket flowerpot that opens to reveal a hidden room full of movie details, an Isabela mini-doll figure, and buildable orchid and cactus LEGO flower toys that can be displayed when the flowerpot is closed. The best part? Kids can continue playing by taking it apart and building it back up with friends or family, or they can display their masterpiece proudly in their room.

items.name: Mattel's Monster High Monster Fest Clawdeen Wolf Fashion Doll
items.desc: What child doesn’t love a doll? And now there are so many dolls that reflect the races, cultures, and styles of kids everywhere. Take Monster High’s Monster Fest Clawdeen Wolf Fashion Doll. This Afro-Latina doll is headed to a music festival and dressed for the occasion. Decked out with accessories like a “freaky-chic” handbag, band posters, snacks, and a “gore-geously glam” makeup look, she’s the perfect doll for a little one to mimic their cool tía (maybe that's you!) and play pretend at their very own music festival.

items.name: American Girl’s Raquel Reyes Doll
items.desc: As a kid, I always wanted an American Girl doll, but one that was unmistakably Latina. And now, not only is the 2026 Girl of the Year Latina, she even shares my name. This moment was definitely worth the wait, but your littles won't have to stand by as long as I did. Raquel Reyes, the kid DJ who loves taste-testing paletas at her family's shop and playing with her pup, is an 18-inch doll with brown eyes and dark-brown hair. Dressed in a Gingham Ruffle Outfit, she spends her days with her primas exploring her family’s history. How cool? Gift it for the little girl in your life or the little girl in you.

items.name: Melissa & Doug’s Spanish See & Spell Language-Learning Toy
items.desc: Okay, so you prefer to give educational gifts? I hear you. If there’s a teeny-tiny in your life, consider Melissa & Doug’s Spanish See & Spell language-learning toy. This wooden puzzle board introduces toddlers to the Spanish alphabet and culturally relevant words like “piña” and “isla.” Perfect for both native speakers and kids learning Spanish, the toy boosts sight-reading vocabulary, letter and color recognition, and fine motor skills.

items.name: Dance With Me Dora Doll
items.desc: Classics are classics for a reason. Created in the early 2000s, Dora the Explorer is just as iconic as she was when she first arrived on Nickelodeon. Now, the little Latina explorer is inspiring a new generation of kiddos. With Spin Master’s Dance with Me, Dora doll, little ones can dance and sing along to bilingual songs with Dora. The toy is educational, interactive, and encourages imaginative play while celebrating Latine culture.

items.name: Enlightened Generation’s Nasca Lines of Peru Collection
items.desc: What about the big kids? They need some educational fun, too. Again, heard. Enlightened Generation creates educational boxes that spark curiosity about the world around them. Through books, fashion, and hands-on discovery activities, kids are inspired to explore, craft, and have meaningful conversations, all while enjoying screen-free, active learning that builds global awareness and empathy. For example, the Nasca Lines of Peru Collection dives into the mysteries of the ancient Nazca Lines, exploring who might have built them, why, and just how enormous some of the designs are. It’s a fun, interactive way for older kids to engage with history, geography, and culture while thinking critically about the world.

items.name: The Shadow Work Self-Reflection Deck
items.desc: The winter season asks us to go inward — both literally and figuratively. It’s a time to pause, rest, and pour into ourselves after a year of overextending. With daylight fading early, it invites self-reflection, and there’s a lot of power in leaning in. If you know someone on a journey of self-discovery — especially exploring shadow work — gift them The Shadow Work Self-Reflection Deck. Created by Black Puerto Rican licensed therapist and author Jor-El Caraballo, the deck features 100 prompts and affirmations designed to deepen mental health exploration, foster personal growth, cultivate self-acceptance, and support emotional well-being.

items.name: Natura’s Ekos Hand Cream Trio
items.desc: Colder weather doesn’t have to mean dry, cracked hands. Brazilian-owned Natura's hand cream trio will help anyone on your list keep their skin hydrated. Formulated with Castanha (Brazil nut), Tukumã (Tucuma palm), and Cacau (cacao), these plant-based ingredients nourish, regenerate, and protect the skin. Plus, they smell absolutely divine.

items.name: Tadin Herb & Tea Co.’s Cinnamon Apple Tea
items.desc: For the friend who loves to romanticize every season, there’s Tadin’s Cinnamon Apple Tea. This delicious blend of freshly ground cinnamon, spicy ginger, and delicately sweet apple is perfect for chilly days.

items.name: Make & Mary’s Ceremonia Frankincense Anointing Oil
items.desc: Frankincense is a resin that has been used for thousands of years in aromatherapy, traditional medicine, and spiritual rituals. Its warm, woody, and slightly citrusy scent has calming and grounding effects that help reduce stress, anxiety, and tension. Make & Mary’s handcrafted Ceremonia Frankincense Anointing Oil is perfect for rituals, meditation, or personal wellness. Your wellness-minded friends can include it in their mind-and-soul practices, like using it during prayer or meditation to deepen focus and connection, or in their physical routines, like gently massaging it onto their skin to soothe inflammation or reduce the appearance of scars. It’s a thoughtful, luxurious gift for anyone looking to cultivate calm, self-care, and intentional living.

items.name: Cubavera’s Contrast Panel Camp Collar Shirt
items.desc: I’ve never met a man who didn’t look good in a fitted button-up. For the vibest styles, there’s Cubavera. The Cuban-American-owned brand’s Contrast Panel Camp Collar Shirt gives off laid-back, Miami cool, making it a versatile pick for just about any occasion.

items.name: Eberjey’s William TENCEL™ Modal Robe
items.desc: For the fella in your life who’d rather be cuddled up on the sofa than throwing back shots at the bar, there’s Eberjey. The Latina-owned loungewear brand makes some of the coziest robes ever, and the William TENCEL™ Modal Robe is no exception. Made from buttery-soft fabric that feels gentle on the skin, it features long sleeves and functional pockets, making it a cozy must-have for him.

items.name: FRSH Company x Bad Bunny’s Mets Snapback
items.desc: For the papi chu who loves style, there’s FRSH Company, a Puerto Rican-owned streetwear brand making hats, tees, hoodies, and more. This year, the brand teamed up with Bad Bunny for a few New Era hats. This classic blue-and-orange Mets snapback features stitching of the Sapo Concho, an endangered frog from Puerto Rico that’s prominently featured in Bad Bunny’s visual albums.

items.name: Kids of Immigrants’ Oxford Button-Up Shirt
items.desc: Kids of Immigrants is a Los Angeles-based streetwear brand co-founded by Honduran designer Daniel Buezo. Inspired by immigrant communities in LA, their tees, hoodies, hats, and totes celebrate children of immigrants who are proud of the neighborhoods and journeys that raised them. That story is woven into this long-sleeve Oxford button-up shirt. The navy-blue and white striped shirt features color-matching navy buttons and the Kids of Immigrants logo, so everyone around them can feel their pride and heritage.

items.name: Boca MMXII’s Metropole Watch
items.desc: When you don’t know what to get a man, you buy him a watch. But Boca MMXII isn’t just any watch brand. Handmade in Mexico using sheepskin, the Metropole Chrono Silver with Bright Tobacco wristband features a stainless steel case and reliable Japanese Seiko TMI VK64 movement. Waterproof and effortlessly cool, it’s a timepiece that’ll look great on his wrist.

items.name: TRESemmé x LUAR's Ana Bag Claw Clip
items.desc: New York-born Dominican designer Raul Lopez grew up watching the women in his life style their hair with TRESemmé. So it only made sense for him to team up with the iconic haircare brand for LUAR’s first-ever hair accessory: the TRESemmé x LUAR Ana Bag Claw Clip. The medium-sized black clip reimagines LUAR’s signature Ana bag silhouette. It's adorable, chic, and the perfect stocking stuffer. Plus, the limited-edition clip comes with a full-size TRESemmé Dry Texture Finishing Spray. Trust us, your stylish bestie is going to love this.

items.name: Touchland’s Salted Caramel Hand Sanitizer
items.desc: Stocking stuffers are the perfect opportunity to gift someone the essentials they often forget, like hand sanitizer. The Latine-owned Touchland has a full lineup of hand sanitizers, including limited-edition seasonal scents. Salted Caramel blends golden cider, rich caramel, and warm amber, leaving hands sanitized, hydrated, and smelling absolutely delicious.

items.name: Little Words Project's Own Your Power Bracelet
items.desc: Sometimes the most fun gifts to give are stocking stuffers, those little pieces that are too small to wrap but carry so much meaning. Little Words Project bracelets are the perfect example. The brand creates beaded affirmation bracelets designed to inspire and empower wearers through daily reminders. And if there’s someone in your life who loves Wicked (chances are, there are many!), the new "Own Your Power" bracelet — with its Elphie green, purple, blue, and gold bead pattern — is perfect. It encourages them to claim their magic, embrace their inner strength, and carry a little joy wherever they go.

items.name: Sazón Grip’s Bonita Socks
items.desc: This one’s for the coquette prima. Sazón Grip is a Guatemalan-owned brand crafting grip socks, and their Bonita pair is absolutely adorable. These peachy-pink, ankle-high socks feature delicate ruffles at the top and have “Bonita” scrawled along the ankle. Not only are they super cute, but they’re also made with breathable, organic cotton, making them soft, eco-friendly, and sweat-wicking.

items.name: Pudiste, Puedes y Podrás Bookmark
items.desc: Every booklover has a collection of bookmarks, yet they always want more. That’s where you come in. Gift the Latina bibliophile in your life this purple-glittery “Pudiste, Puedes y Podrás” bookmark. Every time they pick up their latest read, the affirmation will remind them of all they’ve accomplished, what they’re capable of, and all the amazing things they’ll achieve next.

title: Monet McMichael Lets Us In On the Gifts She’s Giving This Season
intro: This holiday season, we’ve found the gifts that feel great to get and even better to give. Shop our collection of editor-approved holiday gift guides here.

You’re not the only one getting into the holiday spirit. Monet McMichael is already craving the Nochebuena food staples her mom used to make: la navideña, the perfect mix of arroz con gandules, pasteles, and ensalada de papa. But now that McMichael is an adult, the traditions have shifted a bit. She’s the one cooking holiday meals for her own friends.

“Now that I'm an adult and learning how to cook more, I’m hanging out with my aunts and grandmas and learning these family traditions now that I actually care,” the beauty and lifestyle content creator told Refinery29 Somos.
And, as a Puerto Rican girl, she of course can’t forget coquito, the Puerto Rican holiday drink that TasteAtlas recently named the No. 1 cocktail in the world.
“My mom would always bring that to the party, and we’d just link up, hang out, and watch football. It was the best,” she said.

As McMichael reminisces, she’s also preparing for the holiday season. The Afro-Latina star gave us a peek at her Christmas gift list, including all the beauty products she’s buying for her girlfriends and primas.
If you purchase any of these products, we may earn a commission.

items.name: Method method's Pure Peace Volumizing Shampoo + Conditioner Bu
items.desc: Basically everyone on McMichael's list is getting a method Volumizing Shampoo & Conditioner bundle. The content creator teamed up with method in September for a campaign that transformed Grand Central Station into a multi-sensory salon celebrating the power of transformational hair moments. She called the partnership a “natural collab,” noting that she’s been a “big fan” of the brand since her youth, even using her first “big-girl money” to buy the haircare set. While McMichael’s personal favorite is Peony Rose — “it smells so fresh, like flowers, and leaves my hair hydrated” — she’s giving everyone the gift of their own signature scent: Pure Peace, Daily Zen, or Simply Nourish. “I can think of everyone in my life who would like one and know the right scent for each of them,” she said.

items.name: Ocoa Beauty Ocoa Styling Trio
items.desc: For styling, McMichael is treating her wavy- and curly-haired girlfriends to the Ocoa Styling Trio. The Dominican-owned brand’s set includes a curl-defining cream, a gel, and a curl-refresh spray, all made with nourishing ingredients like hibiscus, mango butter, flaxseed, and marula oil.

items.name: Ere Perez's Avocado Waterproof Mascara
items.desc: McMichael is a fan of clean, vegan beauty, so of course Ere Perez made it onto her gifting list. The Mexican-owned brand’s Avocado Waterproof Mascara is waterless and nourishing, making it perfect for anyone with sensitive eyes. It comes in black and brown, and soon it’ll be in one of the content creator’s friends’ Christmas stockings.

items.name: Dezi Skin Dezi's Skin So Balm Makeup-Melting Cleansing Balm
items.desc: Dezi's Skin So Balm Makeup-Melting Cleansing Balm is a best-seller for a reason. The vegan, fragrance-free balm feels silky on the skin as it dissolves daily grime, pollution, and SPF. With this gift, McMichael is helping the people in her life keep their skin soft and hydrated.

items.name: Rizos Curls' Curl Defining Mousse
items.desc: McMichael clearly wants her crew to have hair as flawless as hers. The final haircare item on her list is Rizos Curls' Curl Defining Mousse, a lightweight styling foam that enhances curl definition and deeply hydrates hair without weighing it down.

items.name: Rare Beauty's Soft Pinch Liquid Blush
items.desc: Rare Beauty's Soft Pinch Liquid Blush is on everyone's Christmas list — including McMichael's — because it really is just that good. The viral, bestselling, weightless liquid blush comes in 10 different shades and blends seamlessly for a pinch-perfect flush.

title: 25 Thoughtful Gift Ideas For The Mom Who Does It All
intro: This holiday season, we’ve found the gifts that feel great to get and even better to give. Shop our collection of editor-approved holiday gift guides here.

From navigating our tantrums as toddlers to helping us through personal and professional heartbreaks as adults, is there anything the moms in our lives don't do for us? And while nothing could ever be enough for the woman who literally and figuratively gave us life, we're doing our best to come close with the best gift ideas that won't be repurposed for a work White Elephant or laid to rest in some drawer in your childhood home.

From reader-favorite brands like Lululemon, Jenni Kayne, Caraway, and more, we've curated a mix of covetable fashion, cozy home goods, beauty splurges, personalized trinkets, and many other treasures ahead. (We didn't forget about the picky moms out there, either, picking out practical items they'll appreciate and use for years to come, like gardening tools for the green-fingered or chic cookware for the mom who loves to host.)
All linked products are independently selected by our editors. If you purchase any of these products, we may earn a commission.

items.name: Lululemon Daily Multi-Pocket Tote Bag 20L
items.desc: This elevated tote truly is a modern-day Mary Poppins bag, with handy pockets to divvy up all the essentials and seamlessly take her from workouts to the weekend farmers market. Even better, it’s designed to be water-repellant, so no need to stress, rain or shine.

items.name: Sephora Favorites Holiday Perfume Sampler Set w/ Redeemable Voucher
items.desc: Gifting perfume — even to someone you know as well as your mom — can be a tricky move. Guarantee that she'll love your gift with a fragrance sampler set that allows her to test-drive 20 (!) different perfumes from gourmand to floral. Best of all, the set includes a voucher to get her favorite one as a full-size bottle. (Make a day of it and go to the store with her!)

items.name: Cozy Earth Cuddle Blanket
items.desc: Do we ever really need a reason for a new super-soft, ultra-plush blanket that feels like a hug from her favorite child in bedding form?

items.name: BrooklynSwenson 2026 Bucket List Calendar
items.desc: This hand-painted calendar is designed to inspire fun and adventure every day, with each page dedicated to activities that are seasonally appropriate, wholesome, and manageable — from painting wooden eggs in March to eating dinner by candlelight in October. Your mom can also save them as art prints for future reference.

items.name: The Henry Unwell x Crocs Unfurgettable Clog
items.desc: Cozy slippers are always a "yes" for moms — especially this limited-edition Crocs pair. On the inside, you have a plush footbed and faux fur fluff that feels like a hug for your feet. Sturdy rubber outsoles make it so you can wear them indoors and out. They’re the perfectly practical gift for the mom who likes to take her morning coffee out on the porch.

items.name: Catbird Jewelry Dollhouse Heart Signet Ring
items.desc: Signet rings are traditionally a symbol of family lineage and, of course, diamonds are forever, so, with this gift, you're basically saying you're eternally proud that they're your mom (or mom-type figure).

items.name: Emily Lex Studio Watercolor Set
items.desc: For artsy moms scared to dive into the deep end of the arts and crafts store, or who just don’t have the time to fully commit, this book is great. It includes 10 example paintings to copy, lightly illustrated sketches to get her started, and step-by-step instructions, including tips for mixing colors. It isn’t made with watercolor paper, though, so a pad could be a good follow-up gift.

items.name: Coach Outlet Boxed Snap Wallet And Picture Frame Bag Charm
items.desc: If your mom is still fishing for coins in a decade-old wallet that’s jam-packed with faded receipts and falling apart at the seams, I suggest treating her to a brand-spanking-new one. You can’t go wrong with a style from Coach — these wallets are simple, stylish, and high quality. (For extra aww factor, you can even add a cute photo of you two in the included picture frame charm.)

items.name: Caraway Food Storage Set
items.desc: Do away with your mom’s old, eternally pesto-stained Tupperware and treat her to a complete set of Caraway’s ceramic-coated glass storage containers. Pricey? Yes — but oh so worth it. They’re non-stick, designed to keep your food fresh, and are dishwasher, microwave, oven, refrigerator, and freezer safe.

items.name: Gola Cyclone Sneakers
items.desc: When shopping for a busy mom who’s on her feet all day, you can’t really go wrong with a new pair of stylish sneakers. The Gola Cyclone are a classic choice for their comfort, chic suede upper, and vintage-inspired design.

items.name: Uncommon Originals Book Nook Reading Valet
items.desc: Book-loving moms will adore this veritable shrine to their favorite activity. They can hold their page, set down a drink, house their phone in the opening, and much more. (We all know how annoying and distracting constant notifications can be when you’re trying to relax with a book.)

items.name: FP Movement Pippa Packable Puffer Jacket
items.desc: This practical but stylish jacket has a fan club among Team R29 — and our mothers', too. I’ve had to buy myself a second because my mom has “borrowed” mine for way too long. As an avid birdwatcher and hiker, she loves packing this away just in case the weather turns because of how much less bulky it is than her usual waterproof shell.

items.name: Great Jones The Dutchess
items.desc: We bet mom will be wowed by this sleek cast-iron Dutch oven. Especially when available in an array of beautiful colors, it’ll make quite the statement on her dinner table.

items.name: Jenni Kayne Everyday Sweater
items.desc: Perusing Jenni Kayne's new arrivals is an internet pastime you can count us in on — but the brand's Everyday Sweater, one of its staple offerings, is where it's at for moms. With over 1,660 reviews and a 4.4-stars rating, this lightweight crewneck will be the crown jewel of her knits. It’s super soft and has the perfect slouch for all-day comfort.

items.name: Kate Spade Double Knot Hinged Bangle
items.desc: Love knots have long been used in jewelry to represent the undying bonds between people. Kate Spade has modernized the emblem as a chic, mixed-metal bangle. It’s also hinged, so it's a lot easier to put on.

items.name: Madewell The Essential Bucket Tote
items.desc: Swap out your mom’s purse for this bucket design from Madewell. It's sleek and stylish but understated enough for everyday wear, especially in this expensive chocolate brown shade, which works with everything in her closet.

items.name: Calpak Luka Hanging Toiletry Bag
items.desc: Moms who travel often will love this roomy makeup and toiletries bag. It's quilted to protect their precious glass bottles, has two zippered interior pockets for organization, and a hanging hook so she can have eye-level access to everything.

items.name: Shark Beauty CryoGlow™ Cooling + LED Face Mask
items.desc: This editor-approved LED face mask sets itself apart from the pack with its soothing, de-puffing eye pads — something mom will absolutely adore. With regular use, it can help reduce the appearance of fine lines and redness, as well as stimulate collagen and improve texture and tone. All in all, a functional yet luxurious gift for the skincare-obsessed mom.

items.name: Parachute Cloud Cotton Robe
items.desc: We may be grown up, but Christmas mornings at home will forever be defined by the images of our bleary-eyed moms, wrapped in a robe, coffee in hand, watching sleepily over us as we excitedly open presents or chat about the day. Why not treat her to a brand-new robe to mark the occasion? (Even if we’re all more likely to sleep in these days.) This one is a Parachute best-seller, made in a luxuriously soft and airy Turkish cotton.

items.name: Cole Haan Leather Touch Screen Gloves
items.desc: Keep mom's hands warm in these buttery leather gloves this winter. She won't even have to take them off in the cold when answering calls from you, as they have touchscreen-compatible fingertips.

items.name: Tuckernuck Oxblood Cashmere Blanket Scarf
items.desc: Your mom will love throwing this elegant cashmere blanket scarf over her holiday party wear, especially in this rich berry shade.

items.name: Uncommon Goods Gardener's Tool Seat
items.desc: Gardening moms will love the ease of this tool kit-meets-folding chair. It allows them to set down tools and rest for a while with a cuppa whilst they admire their hard work. It also acts as a comfortable seat for moms who struggle to kneel for a long period of time.

items.name: Pura Best Sellers Set
items.desc: This gift is for all the moms who just need to slow. Things. Down. Rather than a candle, which they can only burn for a season or two, this elevated home diffuser will last them year after year, and they can switch up their scents, depending on their mood.

items.name: Ember Travel Mug 2+
items.desc: For the mom who’s always complaining about their tea or coffee going cold.
